tools.name: shopping_list
tools.description: Turn product picks into a shopping list with plain store URLs. Inputs: items[] of {product_id, region}. Returns each item with a plain merchant URL (no affiliate params yet), estimated price and disclosure, plus a total estimate. Affiliate links are added only after program applications are approved
